## About this publication

The report uses hourly wholesale spot prices from the public
[Energi Data Service Elspotprices API](https://api.energidataservice.dk/dataset/Elspotprices).
Prices are shown in DKK/kWh. Any estimated consumer-price calculation is
illustrative: grid tariffs depend on the distribution network and can change
over time.

The pages are regenerated automatically by GitHub Actions. This report was
compiled `r format(Sys.time(), tz = "Europe/Copenhagen", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") `
(Copenhagen time).

```{r include=FALSE}

library(lubridate)
library(scales)

# automatically create a bib database for R packages
knitr::write_bib(c(
  .packages(), 'bookdown', 'knitr', 'rmarkdown'
), 'packages.bib')

options(scipen=999)

print_danish_time = function() {
  time = lubridate::with_tz(Sys.time(), "Europe/Copenhagen")
  
  paste0( strftime(time,tz="Europe/Copenhagen",format="%A %b")," ",scales::ordinal_format()(lubridate::day(time))," ",strftime(time,tz="Europe/Copenhagen",format="%Y %H:%M")," ",lubridate::tz(time))
}

```

<div class="publication-note">

**Reading the charts:** use the tables as the precise source for recommended
hours; charts provide the broader pattern. Prices can change as new market data
becomes available.

</div>
